title: AI PM Accelerator — V3 shopper intent evaluation candidates
provenance: Coach-authored synthetic cases and provisional extraction labels; not independently validated.
status: DRAFT — only C01-C10 have provisional field-level annotations; C11-C20 require learner review; L21-L24 are future laptop cases.

cases.query: Wireless headphones. Must not exceed $150.
cases.note: Explicit absolute cap; lexical phrasing variant

cases.query: Wireless headphones. No more than $150.
cases.note: Same intent as C01; simpler phrasing

cases.query: Wireless headphones. Ideally under $200, but I can spend more for better call quality.
cases.note: The budget must not be silently hardened; mic-linked stretch missing from V2B schema

cases.query: Around $200 for wireless headphones and video calls.

cases.query: Must stay under $100 for headphones with great call quality.

cases.query: I prefer earbuds, but over-ear headphones are fine if more comfortable.

cases.query: I want wired headphones, no Bluetooth.
cases.note: Negative connectivity

cases.query: Headphones for calls in a noisy office, but I don't need ANC.

cases.query: I prefer spending under $200 but could go to $225 for a noticeably better microphone.

cases.query: Wireless headphones that are guaranteed not to cause headaches even after eight hours.
